title: Display Gaussian mixture assignments
description: You inspect the optional library fit and its component-mean overlay.

steps.description: You fit a two-component Gaussian mixture when SKLEARN_AVAILABLE is true. The same observations receive predicted component labels.

steps.question: Which values determine point colors and which determine the large x markers?
steps.answer: skl_labels determines observation colors. skl_means supplies the component means drawn as large x markers.

steps.description: You plot both feature coordinates and title the figure Hard Assignments. Each point receives one predicted component label in this display.
You print a skip message when the availability guard fails. The supplied output includes no numeric component means or assignments.
